painHook.title:

You didn’t wake up.
painHook.copy: By the time you realize it, the morning is already running without you.

insight.title: This isn’t a motivation problem.
insight.copy: Your alarm asks you to make a good decision before your brain is fully awake.

shift.snooze_unaware: The mission you pick tonight makes snoozing a dead end.
shift.dismiss_fall_asleep: The alarm keeps ringing until the mission is done — going back to sleep is not an option.
shift.multiple_alarms: One alarm, one mission. There are no backup alarms to ignore.
shift.louder_background: Volume isn’t the fix — a mission can’t become background noise.
shift.sleepy_ignores: Tonight’s plans become tomorrow’s locked-in mission.
shift.late_frustrated: Your first win of the day happens before you’re fully awake.

solution.title: Take the decision away from your sleepy brain.
solution.copy: DawnVow keeps ringing until you complete the mission you chose the night before.
